description: The dialect crate's embedded seed: gen dialect snapshots the canonical dialect's contributing documents into the crate itself, at src/dialect/, and compile.rs includes each through its own crate-relative include_str! path beside the CANONICAL_VERSION constant naming the version the documents declare — so the published crate is self-contained, reading no file outside itself. The harness requires the snapshot bytes to equal the live canonical documents under pkg/kdl/schemas/dialect (a stale or drifted snapshot fails here), and the generated compile.rs to carry the four crate-relative includes and the version constant

command: grep -o 'include_str!("dialect/[a-z]*\.kdl")' out/src/compile.rs; grep 'pub const CANONICAL_VERSION' out/src/compile.rs
stdout-contains:
include_str!("dialect/types.kdl")
include_str!("dialect/bindings.kdl")
include_str!("dialect/context.kdl")
include_str!("dialect/documents.kdl")
pub const CANONICAL_VERSION: &str = "0";
